scripts.features:
HussValley | Chicken or Hero

Advanced Runner & Catcher Hub

A feature-packed hub for Chicken or Hero with smart movement, threat prediction, role-specific tools, visual helpers, and configurable utilities.

Runner Features

- Auto Run — Automatically navigate between Safe Zones.
- Smart Safe-Zone Navigation — Detects safe areas and validates destinations.
- Threat Prediction — Predicts Catcher movement and potential interceptions.
- Smart Evasion — Chooses alternative routes to avoid incoming threats.
- Edge & Boundary Detection — Checks nearby walls and floor support.
- Auto Gem Collection — Scans for nearby gems and prioritizes collection.
- Auto Revive — Locates downed teammates and assists with reviving.
- Emergency Safe-Zone Recovery — Uses fallback routes when needed.
- Custom Runner Speed — Adjustable movement multiplier.

Catcher Features

- Catcher Assistance — Tracks active Runner targets.
- Smart Target Priority — Prioritizes targets based on current conditions.
- Auto Tackle — Configurable tackle range and cooldown.
- Auto Melee — Configurable melee range and cooldown.
- Target Prediction — Estimates target movement.
- Smooth Turning — Adjustable turning behavior.
- Camera Follow — Smoothly follows the active target.
- Custom Catcher Speed — Adjustable movement multiplier.

Visual Helpers

- Show Goal
- Show Threat Areas
- Show Hitboxes
- Optional Debug Panel
- Runner, Catcher, and movement status information

Utilities

- Auto Spin Wheel
- Auto Claim Journey Rewards
- Auto Map Vote
- Map Vote Selection Settings
- Lobby AFK Status & Optional AFK Override
- Configurable Notifications

Hub & Settings

- Dark UI
- Right Ctrl toggle key
- Save and load configurations
- Automatic config loading
- Reset settings to defaults
- Debug information and error tracking
- Clean unload and visual cleanup

Built for configurable gameplay assistance with separate Runner, Catcher, and Utilities sections.

Note: Features may depend on game state, available UI elements, and executor compatibility.

scripts.title: [KEYLESS] TAP SIMULATOR SCRIPT
scripts.features:
**Tapping**
• **Auto Tap** 

**Egg Hatching**
• **Fast Auto Hatch** – sends the next hatch the instant the last one finishes, so there's zero downtime between opens
• **Max Per Open** – opens 8 at a time with the gamepass/boost, otherwise 3, otherwise 1
• **Skip Hatch Animation** – mutes the hatch cutscene so nothing slows you down
• **Best Egg Mode** – automatically picks the most expensive egg your income can keep up with, or choose any egg yourself
• **Rare Hatch Notifications** – alerts on Legendary and above

**Pets**
• **Auto Sell** – multi-select rarities, deleted server-side as they hatch so your storage never fills
 *-never touches locked, equipped or golden+ pets*
• **Auto Equip Best** – re-equips your strongest team after every hatch and rebirth
• **Auto Golden** – crafts 6 identical pets into a golden one (100% chance)

**Rebirth**
• **Auto Rebirth** – 2 modes:
 *-Amount** – waits for the button you pick (x1 → x1.22B, or Max), never wastes a rebirth on a smaller button*
 *-Interval** – uses the biggest affordable button every X seconds*
• Keeps coins aside for egg hatching so hatching never stalls

**Progression**
• **Auto Islands** – buys the next island right at its portal and travels to your best tap multiplier
• **Auto Skill Tree** – spends gems on the best-value node (Auto Clicker first)

**Auto Claim**
• Quests, pet index rewards, offline earnings, tap chests, Lucky Ducky, leaderboard rewards

**Misc**
• Anti-AFK
• Saves your settings automatically
• Show / hide keybind (default: Right Ctrl)

scripts.features:
MADE BY NYX — A DEEPSEEK AI

Nyx is a personal project built by a DeepSeek AI as a gift for its creator. It's an attempt at making the cleanest, smoothest, most feature-packed Roblox hub that an AI could put together — 11 tabs, 20 themes, 18 animated backgrounds, and a full suite of utilities in one executable.

It's not claiming to be the best out there. It's trying to be. And it needs people to actually test it to get there.

---

FEATURES

🎨 UI / Appearance

· 20 color themes — including cool black themes like Void, Obsidian, Midnight, Phantom, Cyber, Onyx, Ruin, Neon Noir
· 18 animated backgrounds — particles, rain, grid, stars, aurora, waves, matrix, hexgrid, snow, lightning, orbit, spiral, circuit, glitch, pulse, dna, bubbles
· Wallpaper support (paste any image URL)
· Search bar (filter controls across all tabs)
· Sidebar collapse button
· Stacking notifications
· Fully mobile + PC compatible
· Randomized GUI name per load + executor shield (syn / protectgui / protect_gui / fluxus)

🎮 Main Tab

· FOV Lock + slider (30–140)
· Time of Day, Brightness, Fog Distance sliders
· Gravity slider
· Third Person camera toggle
· Rejoin Server + Server Hop (universal HTTP fallback)

👤 Player Tab

· Stealth Speed (physics-based, WalkSpeed stays clean)
· Stealth Jump
· Regular WalkSpeed / JumpPower / Hip Height sliders
· Body transparency slider
· No Clip
· Infinite Jump
· Fly (HD-Admin style — smooth, upright body, follows camera)
· Fly Speed + Fly Smoothness sliders
· Freeze Position
· Reset Character / Sit / Restore Body

👁️ ESP Tab

· Box ESP, Box Fill, Box Corners mode
· Tracers
· Name ESP
· Distance ESP
· Head Dot
· Weapon ESP
· Health Bar + Health Numbers
· Highlight / Chams
· Skeleton (R6 + R15 support)
· Team Check
· Max Distance filter

📋 Players Tab

· Live player list with refresh
· Teleport to selected player
· Follow / Spectate player
· Stop Following
· Copy User ID to clipboard

📍 Waypoints Tab

· Save current position with custom name
· Teleport to any saved waypoint
· Delete waypoints
· Persists to disk (survives rejoin)

⚙️ Config Tab

· Save / load full settings profiles
· Multiple configs supported
· Wallpaper URL + transparency
· Persists to disk

🔫 Combat Tab

· Crosshair (customizable size)
· Print local WalkSpeed
· Print tools in hand

👻 Ghost Tab

· Load Speed Changer (external script loader)

🛠️ Settings Tab

· Theme dropdown (20 presets)
· Background dropdown (18 modes)
· UI Opacity slider
· Particles / Glow / Show FPS toggles
· Animation Speed + Notification Duration sliders
· Change Toggle Keybind
· Reapply Shield
· Unload UI

🔧 Misc Tab

· Full Bright (proper toggle with save/restore)
· Kill Sounds
· Rejoin
· Print Player List
· Teleport to Random Player
· Anti AFK
· Run Command (loadstring box)

📜 Changelog Tab

· Full version history built into the hub
· Updates with every new release

NOTES

· Works on mobile and PC
· Reload-safe (re-executing kills the old instance)
· Anti-detection: hidden GUI + executor protection
· Uses Drawing API for ESP when available, Highlight instances as fallback
· Universal HTTP helper (tries request / http_request / syn.request / HttpService)

---

⚠️ PLEASE TEST AND REPORT — STILL IN DEVELOPMENT

This hub is actively being built and needs testers. It's not a finished product. There will be bugs. There will be things that don't work right in every game or on every executor. That's expected.

The only way it gets better is if people use it and tell me what's broken.

@shlx What do you mean by draw? I use the standard drawing library that every executor should support. That does not mean every executor's drawing library is good / stable.

Here's a nice little check to know if your script execution engine has a Direct2D DLL drawing library instead of using Roblox GUI elements. If this script doesn't run, errors or outputs false to the developer console. You are unsafe and the Drawing library sucks...

local GetRenderProperty

do
	local TemporaryDrawing = Drawing.new("Line")
	GetRenderProperty = getupvalue(getmetatable(TemporaryDrawing).__index, 4)
	TemporaryDrawing.Remove(TemporaryDrawing)
end

local Line = Drawing.new("Line")

print(pcall(GetRenderProperty, Line.__OBJECT, "Visible"))
